steps.evidence: README.md:11-35 (separate Laravel app with Breeze API scaffolding, migrated and served on :8000 with APP_URL/FRONTEND_URL set)

notes: The README says `yarn install` or `npm install`. Only package-lock.json (lockfile v2) is committed, so npm is the actual package manager. The frontend needs a separately created Laravel Breeze API backend (PHP, Composer and a database, per Laravel's defaults) running at http://localhost:8000. That backend lives outside this repo, so it is recorded as a manual step rather than a service. The Next dev server itself starts without it, but every auth/API call fails. The .env.example default (NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000) can be copied unchanged. `yarn install`/`npm install` and the .env copy are written inline or in prose in the README, not in code blocks. The workflows only automate Dependabot, issues and PRs; there is no build/test CI. No Node version is stated.
